aeonik.$description: Display and heading face for all editorial moments — 148px hero headlines, 72px section openers, 48px card titles, 32px subheadings. Fixed at weight 500; the brand never goes bolder. Tracking pulls tight at -0.02em which gives the geometric forms a sculpted, almost engraved quality at large sizes. Substitute: 'Söhne', 'Inter', or 'General Sans'.

geist.$description: UI and body face for everything below the headline tier — body copy, buttons, labels, captions, card descriptions, nav links. Weight 500 is the workhorse; 600 only for tiny 10px micro-labels. The 18px / 20px sizes with -0.01em tracking carry the interface's conversational voice. Substitute: 'Geist', 'Inter', or 'Söhne'.
